text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — error-rate spike and backpressure detected for /v1/generate (us-west-2). Routing shows progressive fallback to model variant 'lite-xl-quant' causing precipitous increases in cold starts and token latency. Suspected amplification from client retries. Auto-pager sent to oncall.
jonathan-oncall: on it, paging ops and runtime. grabbing runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/routing-fallback
sam-ops: data point — 500s and 503s spiked at 19:10 UTC, downstream requests to lite-xl-quant jumped 6x after fallback began. clients with aggressive retries are stacking. customer-facing errors on 3 keys (acme-inc, betaship) — kate, can you confirm?
kate-support: acme-inc reporting timeouts and many failed responses. I've opened a support tile; customers seeing 10-20s latencies then 503. Escalating to CSMs.
leigh-runtime: quick mitigation: disable automatic model fallback for the cluster policy. temp command below to flip policy (console API):

```
curl -X POST 'https://controlplane.redwood/api/v1/policies/routing/fallback' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"enabled":false, "reason":"incident hotfix"}'
```

I'll push the change now.
deploy-bot: policy-change: routing.fallback toggled -> false by leigh-runtime at 19:14 UTC
sam-ops: also recommendation: apply egress rate-limit per client + short-circuit to 429 for heavy clients. pushing a temporary throttle at the edge (nginx):

```
location /v1/generate {
  limit_req zone=clients burst=20 nodelay;
}
```
mira-ml: root cause note — 'lite-xl-quant' was tagged as compatible with the routing policy yesterday but we've seen it has much higher cold-start duty due to kernel init on that hardware profile. When fallback routes heavy cross-region, the cold-starts pile up.
jonathan-oncall: good catch. for now we should prefer same-region warm variants over cross-region lite fallback. can we patch smart-routing to prefer region-local compatible variants first?
leigh-runtime: short-term done: routing preference set to region->variant->cost (was cost->variant->region). applied at 19:16 UTC.
deploy-bot: config-change: routing.preference updated by leigh-runtime
sam-ops: monitoring shows 40% reduction in failover attempts after preference flip. errors still elevated from retries; need client-side backoff enforcement.
jonathan-oncall: kate, can you contact the top 5 keys to ask teams to implement exponential backoff? include header suggestion: `X-Redwood-Recommended-Backoff: 500,1000,2000` (ms)
kate-support: pinged acme-inc and betaship. acme says they already have linear 200ms retries; asking them to switch to exponential. sending template.
elaine: I'm taking over on-call in 30m. jonathan, handoff in 10. summarize current state and next steps here.
jonathan-oncall: handoff summary: incident triggered by routing fallback to lite-xl-quant causing cold-start surge. amplification from client retries produced thundering herd. Mitigations applied: disabled auto-fallback, changed routing preference to favor region-local variants, edge rate-limit, support contacting top customers for backoff. Current status: error rate down ~60%, but still above baseline. Remaining work: client enforcement, long-term fix = patch compatibility tagging + warm-pool for lite variants.
elaine: acknowledged. I'll coordinate follow-ups, and kick off a capacity bump if errors climb again. taking over at 19:40 UTC.
mira-ml: action item for ML infra: add a compatibility test in model onboarding that simulates cold-start traffic and marks lite variants as "cold-heavy" so routing can avoid them unless absolutely necessary.
leigh-runtime: ops action: create a temporary warm pool for lite-xl-quant in us-west-2 to reduce cold starts. doing scale-up of +4 nodes now.
sam-ops: scale-up command:

```
redwood infra scale --pool lite-xl-quant-usw2 --add 4
```
deploy-bot: scale-job queued by leigh-runtime
kate-support: customer impact note added to incident page: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1977123456 — ACME sla risk flagged.
jonathan-oncall: status update posted to #incidents-summary. handing to elaine for next steps.
elaine: taking over. I'll schedule a postmortem and make sure the sequencing of compatibility tag fixes and routing preference is prioritized. assigning owners: mira -> onboarding tests, leigh -> warm pool automation, sam -> edge throttling defaults. kate -> customer comms.
jonathan-oncall: handing off fully. ping me if escalation to execs needed.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: error-rate trending down, 15 min window shows median latency improving. next update in 15.
(19:38 UTC) elaine: brief note for timeline: root cause = incorrect compatibility tag + prioritization by cost causing cross-region fallback. amplification = client retries + absence of per-client rate-limits. Proposed follow-ups:
- onboarding gauge for cold-start characteristics
- default edge throttles for API keys beyond X rps
- change fallback to prefer same-region warm variants
- run customer outreach template and retry guidance

elaine: marking this thread for postmortem; I'll draft summary and timeline after incident stabilizes. :white_check_mark:
